note: Directory of strategies: for Cameroon it states the Plan Stratégique National de Santé Numérique 2026-2030 was launched 4 March 2026 with a CFA 29 billion envelope, and that a 2025 evaluation of the 2020-2024 plan scored system maturity 1.8 out of 5; it names no Cameroonian health information system, so no fact attaches to an hmis or emr system.
